title: Minnesota man killed his wife and child before dying by suicide, police say
description:
Police said they believed deceased man was assailant in domestic-related homicide at daycare center

A man killed a woman and their child inside a small in-home daycare center they own in Minnesota before taking his own life, police said on Wednesday.

Hopkins police department said in statement they responded to a report of a stabbing at the residence on the 200 block of Tyler Avenue North around 9am in the Minneapolis suburb of Hopkins. Inside, they found two adults and a child dead.
